newsitem.title: ITALY: Naples named as venue for Italo-French summit.
newsitem.headline: Naples named as venue for Italo-French summit.

text.p: A summit of Italian and French leaders on October 3 and 4 will take place in Naples, the Italian Foreign Ministry said on Monday.
It said the two-day meeting would be held at the southern port city's Royal Palace, venue for the 1994 Group of Seven summit of leading industrialised nations.
French President Jacques Chirac and Italy's Prime Minister Romano Prodi will head the meeting, whose dates were announced last week.

Chirac abruptly called off a planned meeting with Prodi's predecessor Lamberto Dini in Sicily last November in response to Italian government criticism of French nuclear tests. Dini is now foreign minister and will attend the Naples summit.
